rationale: Actual138 completed32 batches but original full-three merit remained near4.96321378929 and the complete normal-trace selector directly rescued0 failed original working candidates. This independent single eight-direction child reforms every response column along a complete9-dimensional QR basis and directly evaluates its actual chosen direction under R310; it starts at the true actual138 final parameters and final radius. It makes no precision, descent, root, rank or native acceptance guarantee.

family.formula: sum p_i*b_i + sum theta_i*b_i*t_i + sum eta_i*b_i*t_i^2, t_i=2*x_i-1

direction_model.parameter_scaling: S_j=max(1,abs(current p_j)); physical d=V*w; actual relative step is formed d/S
direction_model.relative_trust_ball: ||formed d/S||_2 <= Delta; initial Delta is true actual138 final3.814697265625e-7; carry original saved radius with no reset, clamp or repair
direction_model.positive_damped_objective: min_w ||r+K*w||_2^2 + mu^2*||G*w||_2^2; finite G retained instead of silently substituting identity
direction_model.damping_selection: Original positive floor epsilon*max(1,Frobenius(pilot_J*S)); at most64 upper bracketing and64 geometric refinements; keep an actual formed in-radius upper solve. No new weak-singular-value threshold.
direction_model.linear_solver: Complete scipy.linalg.qr economic/pivoting of every entry of12x9 [K;mu*G] plus full9x9 solve_triangular; no normal-matrix solve, lstsq/rcond or SVD truncation.
direction_model.nonlinear_trial: The unchanged R299 helper runs q=p+alpha*d+S*N*w with pilot9x2 normal plane, original20 alpha2^-j and original12x20 normal budget. Target is original c(p)+alpha*a[1:], using the directly evaluated full3 action. R299 chooses only actual finite states in each completed normal trace. No new real trial or normal Jacobian call is added by response formation.
direction_model.acceptance: Original finite-domain rules and nonnegative/nonfinite slope stop remain; slope is r^T*a from the actual chosen-direction complex response. A candidate is accepted only by the original real full3 unweighted merit <= W(p)+.2*alpha*r^T*a. This finite approximate slope is not certified as derivative of the true corrected path.
direction_model.radius_update: after an accepted step keep actual108 rule: halve on alpha<1 or ratio<.25/undefined; double up to1 on ratio>.75 and scaled step>=.8Delta; otherwise retain; after all20 rejections quarter the radius and do not adopt any candidate
direction_model.direction_budget: eight total complete direction attempts; both accepted and rejected directions consume one
direction_model.radius_after_full_rejection: Delta <- Delta/4; preserve current accepted nine-control p/state/fresh3x9 J; recompute the complete predictor and normal frame on the next budgeted direction
direction_model.direction_solve_failure_or_nonnegative_s: honest stop, not a new acceptance gate
direction_model.normal_correction: Unchanged d4c9 R299 normal helper: original model.jacobian along all9 axes and complete2x2 projected pilot-normal QR, at most12 Newton iterations and20 inner Armijo backtracks. R310 optional normal_directional_response is not called.
direction_model.correction_tolerance: 1e-8 absolute in the original two unit-equation target errors is only an inner stopping target, never an outer acceptance gate
direction_model.seed_domain_scope: an invalid original direct seed ends that alpha; this run does not subdivide the curve to bypass an invalid seed
direction_model.path_origin: q(0,0)=p. In a smooth model with invertible C*P, q_prime(0)=d+P*(C*P)^-1*(a_constraints-C*d). Equality to d requires true a_constraints=C*d. Stored pilot-axis curve-origin readback does not assert trueDF or floating-program differentiability.

returned_candidate_selection.algorithm_change_from135: Historical R299 change already present in actual138; this request retains it byte-for-byte

direction_model.complete_basis: Use original axis3x9 pilot only to form full9x9 pivoted Householder Q of the transposed row-balanced pilot*diag(S); retain all9 columns including weak/null pilot columns. V=diag(S)*Q; G is formed V/S.
direction_model.recomputed_response: For each of all9 V columns, call unchanged original finite family evaluate(p+i*1e-25*V_j) and divide its full3 imaginary residual by original1e-25. K is these9 actual responses, not pilot_J*V.
direction_model.actual_chosen_direction_action: After forming physical d=V*w, one further original evaluate(p+i*1e-25*d) supplies a=imag(equation)/1e-25. Stored pilot_J*d and K*w are separate readbacks, never silently substituted.

original_model_and_checks.scope: Original circle transfer and physical/domain formulas are retained; this new family extends scalar jets and control derivatives, not the number of physical resonance rows.
